evidence_sources.excerpt: I finally got around to installing uBlock Origin Lite on iOS. I used to run the Firefox version on iOS, but that was discontinued long ago, and I never replaced it.  I feel like a bit of an idiot for not doing this sooner.

source_story_title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
